title: Feature request: SMB enable/disable button
symptom: Users want a button on the main screen to enable/disable SMB (Super Micro Bolus) for convenience, especially at night.
fix: The thread suggests using a high temp target to disable SMBs, and a commit link is provided that may implement the feature.
evidence_quote: If you want to temporarily disable SMB's, you could just set a high temp target and adjust your settings accordingly so that SMB's are disabled with a high TT.
